summary: Tests that can't run in CI get the unsupported alias from their contributor; run them with --allow-unsupported or an unsupported/ prefix.
questions: How do I mark a test that can't run in CI?
How do I run an unsupported integration test locally?

answer_card.title: Unsupported tests
answer_card.answer_md: Mark with `unsupported` (by the contributor) when simulators or cloud plugins can't make it CI-runnable. Run with `--allow-unsupported` or prefix `unsupported/`.
